mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the water was the most worthwhile moment because the result explained that clearer water can still contain harmful microbes, giving the boiling step a clear purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: Covering the filled jar was straightforward and predictable, though it completed the storage goal.

surprise.text: The explanation that harmful microbes may remain after filtering clarified why the water needed another treatment.

arbitrary.text: The filter bed and hollow pipe made a water filter, but the result did not explain how the pipe housed or connected to the bed.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: assembling the separate water systems was coherent, and the filtering explanation added something useful.
